routes.label: Studio-designated podcast playlist
routes.limitations: A podcast is a playlist of episode videos; a designated playlist may still be ineligible for podcast features

routes.label: Existing creator-owned video episodes
routes.limitations: A direct audio-only MP3 is not an ordinary episode video upload; existing/new videos are added to a podcast playlist

routes.label: RSS audio to static-image video importer
routes.limitations: YouTube creates a static-image video for RSS audio; back catalog imports can start private; it will not syndicate to outside podcast apps

routes.label: YouTube Music podcast audio-only experience
routes.limitations: Most podcast content may permit background and download without YouTube Music Premium; no guarantee for each show

routes.label: Short clips separate from podcast episodes
routes.limitations: Promotional Shorts are not episodes in YouTube Music podcast listings

routes.label: Rights and sponsor disclosure gate
routes.limitations: Copyright claims can remove podcast feature eligibility; sponsored segments need policy-compliant disclosure

constraints: Manual audio-file upload as an ordinary YouTube video is not the same as the RSS converter creating static-image videos automatically.
RSS import is supported only in selected regions and may require additional verification. Do not infer a specific creator's access.
Podcast episodes are video entries inside a playlist; unrelated Shorts or other channels' videos do not become YouTube Music podcast episodes automatically.
Background play/download availability for most YouTube Music podcasts does not mean every show or listener gets unrestricted free Premium music services.
RSS delivery uploads to YouTube/YouTube Music only, not to external podcast directories.
RSS-episode titles, artwork, music, recordings, show ownership and embedded brand disclosures retain underlying licensing and platform-policy requirements.
Podcast ranking, watch-time analytics and cash are different measurements; no observed creator profit follows from upload permission.
